abstract: Investigating the mechanisms underlying maturation of metastases of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors on administration of chemotherapy, the histologic characteristics of primary testis tumors was compared to the histologic characteristics of their retroperitoneal metastases in three historical patient groups. The metastases in Group I (20 patients) were not treated; those in Groups II (nine patients) and III (24 patients) were treated, respectively, with three cycles of dactinomycin and with four cycles of cis-diammine-dichloroplatinum, vinblastine, and bleomycin, before retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. In Group III there was a significant increase of metastases consisting of differentiated teratoma only, as compared to the metastases of Group I. However, both with and without chemotherapy, the metastases contained fewer areas of differentiated teratoma than the primary lesions. Metastases containing differentiated teratoma with and without other components, with one exception in Group III, were derived from primary tumors containing mature areas as well. Components other than mature teratoma were almost completely eradicated in Group III. These findings strongly suggest that selective destruction of components other than differentiated teratoma causes the mature histologic characteristics in the metastases upon administration of chemotherapy. The results do not support the hypothesis of induction of differentiation by the chemotherapeutic agents.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣と後腹膜リンパ節転移の組織学的特徴を、3つの歴史的患者群で比較し、化学療法による転移巣の成熟化の機序を検討した。第I群(20例)の転移巣は未治療であった。第II群(9例)と第III群(24例)は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の前に、それぞれダクチノマイシンによる3サイクル、およびシスプラチン・ビンブラスチン・ブレオマイシンによる4サイクルの治療を受けた。第III群では、第I群と比べて分化型奇形腫のみからなる転移巣が有意に増加した。しかし、化学療法の有無にかかわらず、転移巣は原発巣より分化型奇形腫の領域が少なかった。分化型奇形腫以外の成分は第III群でほぼ完全に消失していた。分化型奇形腫を含む転移巣は、1例を除き、成熟した領域も有する原発巣に由来していた。これらの所見は、化学療法による分化型奇形腫以外の成分の選択的破壊が、転移巣の成熟組織像をもたらすことを強く示唆する。化学療法剤による分化誘導という仮説は支持されない。
